gross_sales.definition: Total item value before discounts and refunds.

discount_amount.definition: Total discounts applied to completed order items.

refund_amount.definition: Total amount refunded for returned items.
rules: Refunds come from the returns table.
Revenue in this project means net revenue unless the user asks for gross sales.

average_order_value.definition: Average net revenue generated per completed order.

repeat_customer.definition: A customer with at least two completed orders in the selected period.
rules: The selected analysis period must be applied before counting orders.

active_customer.definition: A customer with at least one completed order in the selected period.
rules: The selected analysis period must be applied before counting orders.
